name: Shape Lab
tagline: Flat primitives on an electric-blue grid: they morph, pixel-step, shatter and swap colour on the cut.
description: A design-reel language built from pure geometry: rectangles, circles, rings, bars and star bursts on an electric-blue blueprint grid. Shapes morph into each other (two blocks become a bar, a bar becomes a circle, a circle a set of rings), edges render pixel-stepped as if rasterised mid-move, and forms dissolve into dither particles. The edit is fast and graphic: hard cuts on the beat that keep the composition and flip the palette (blue/white → black/gold), with rare beats of 3D (an extruded slab, a wireframe rig) and dense line moiré.
bestFor: brand launches built on a simple mark

signature: shape morph: one primitive becomes the next (two blocks → a bar → a circle → rings), hard in-out ease
palette-flip cut: a hard cut on the beat that keeps the composition and swaps the palette (blue/white → black/gold → white/blue)
pixel dissolve: the form rasterises into stepped edges and dither, then scatters into particles that reform
avoid: gradients except on the rare 3D slab

camera: Mostly locked and flat, looking straight at the grid. Rare 3D beats: an extruded slab tips over on a white floor, a wireframe rig turns in perspective, a moiré ribbon sweeps through depth. Punch-ins are cuts, not moves.

texture.notes: Clean vector colour on a fine blueprint grid (thin lines at ~10 % ink). Pixel-stepped edges and ordered dither appear only while a shape transforms or dissolves; thin bounding boxes and hairline guides show briefly like a design tool's selection.

lighting: Flat. Only the 3D beats are lit: soft studio light on a satin slab, cool reflections, no hard shadows.
sound: Tight electronic: clicks, blips and digital glitches on every cut, a synth pulse driving the montage, whooshes on morphs, a short riser into the densest beat.

beats.label: Two blocks on the grid merge into a bar

motionSummary: Moves like a design tool on fast-forward: flat primitives snap and morph into each other on an electric-blue grid, edges pixel-step mid-move, and hard cuts on the beat flip the palette.

composition: one or two primitives centred or on a strong axis, lots of flat colour around them
a fine blueprint grid behind everything, with hairline guides and selection boxes appearing during moves
full-frame splits: a white column in a blue field, black panels with tiny UI marks
visual.shapeLanguage: pure primitives: rectangles, circles, rings and arcs, bars, 4- to 16-point star bursts and sparkles, rounded blobs; flat fill or 2 px outline; edges go pixel-stepped while transforming
visual.contrast: saturated electric blue against paper white, with black and a single warm accent (gold) or a red line for the number moments; one palette per shot, swapped on the cut

grammar.pacing: fast montage: shots of 0.3–1.5 s (mean ~0.75 s, about 13 cuts per 10 s), with one or two longer 2–3 s morph shots as breathers
grammar.rhythm: beat-cut: every cut and every shape snap lands on a beat; morphs fill the bar between
grammar.easing: hard in-out for morphs and slides ([0.76,0,0.24,1], [0.83,0,0.17,1]); a snappy overshoot spring for pops; stepped (steps 6–10) while a shape is pixel-rendered
grammar.acceleration: near-instant starts and stops: shapes sit still, snap across the frame in 6–10 f, and land dead
movement: scale pop with a small overshoot
pixel-step and dither dissolve into particles
concentric rings rotating at different speeds
grammar.density: low most of the time (1–3 shapes), with two or three dense bursts (particle fields, moiré, wireframe tangles)
grammar.holds: very short (4–10 f) on each composition; the grid never moves

transitionPresets.name: Shape morph
transitionPresets.build: interpolate width, height and corner radius (rect → pill → circle) or split/merge blocks; hard in-out ease, 10–20 f; land on a beat
transitionPresets.sound: a short whoosh ending in a click

transitionPresets.name: Palette-flip cut
transitionPresets.build: hard cut on the beat to the identical layout with the palette swapped (blue bg/white shape → black bg/gold shape → white bg/blue shape); 2–4 flips in a row accelerate a phrase

transitionPresets.name: Pixel dissolve
transitionPresets.build: switch the shape's edge to a coarse step (8–16 px blocks), break it into ordered-dither particles that drift and scatter (8–14 f), and reform them as the next shape

transitionPresets.name: Ring zoom
transitionPresets.build: the circle grows past the frame edge while concentric rings and arcs spawn inside it at different rotation speeds; the inner ring becomes the next shot's circle

transitionPresets.name: Burst wipe
transitionPresets.build: a 12–16 point star pops at an edge (spring) and scales to cover the frame in 6–8 f; the next shot is revealed inside its silhouette

transitionPresets.name: Slab tip
transitionPresets.build: a flat rect gains depth (extrude) and tips over on a white floor in perspective; on landing, cut flat to the next shot

archetypes.name: Primitive pair
archetypes.purpose: the opening: simple, confident, the brand's geometry
archetypes.composition: one to three flat primitives on the blue grid, on a clear axis
archetypes.elements: rectangles, circles or a bar in white
archetypes.motion: shapes snap into place, slide, merge into one

archetypes.name: Ring orbit
archetypes.purpose: focus and system: something at the centre with things around it
archetypes.composition: a centred circle with concentric rings and arcs, thin and thick, some broken
archetypes.elements: rings, arcs, a dot, hairline guides
archetypes.motion: rings rotate at different speeds, pixel-step on the move, a pulse ripples outward

archetypes.name: Burst field
archetypes.composition: a cluster of star bursts and sparkles breaking out of a blob, with dither debris
archetypes.elements: 4–16 point stars (filled and outlined), sparkles, a rounded blob, scattered particles
archetypes.motion: stars pop with overshoot, spin a little, debris scatters; palette flips on the beat

archetypes.name: Depth beat
archetypes.purpose: a moment of craft: the flat world gains a dimension
archetypes.composition: an extruded slab on a white floor, a wireframe rig, or a moiré ribbon in perspective
archetypes.elements: one 3D primitive or a line field, still in the palette
archetypes.motion: tips, turns or sweeps through depth, then cuts flat
archetypes.camera: a slow orbit or fixed perspective

archetypes.name: Number plate
archetypes.purpose: the message: a word, number or name
archetypes.composition: a framed panel (hairline box with corner sparkles) holding a thin outlined number or a short line of type
archetypes.elements: thin display type (light weight, outline or red line), a mono caption, sparkles at the corners
archetypes.motion: lines draw on, the number traces, sparkles pop at the corners

beats.purpose: the system: shapes transform into each other

beats.motion: palette-flip cuts accelerate, bursts and dither
the plate draws on, the word or number traces
shapes return to the opening layout, the name sits small

sequence.cutRhythm: fast: a cut every 0.3–1.5 s on the beat, bursts of 2–4 palette-flip cuts at phrase ends, one or two 2–3 s morph shots

scenes.action: two white blocks on the blue grid snap together into a single bar on the downbeat
the bar rounds into a circle, rings spawn around it at different speeds, edges pixel-step as they turn
a star burst pops out of a blob; three palette-flip cuts (blue/white → black/gold → white/blue) on the hi-hats; debris dithers away
the particles reform as a white slab that tips over on a white floor
a hairline frame with corner sparkles draws on; 'v2' traces in thin red line
cut back to the two blocks; the product name sits small between them

elements.text: rare and small: a thin display weight for one word or number (outlined or a single red line), mono for a caption; never paragraphs
elements.logo: reduced to its primitives first (its circle, its bar), which morph into the true mark for the lockup
elements.icons: rebuilt as flat primitives or star bursts
elements.images: avoided; if needed, a screen as a flat white panel with a few UI marks, or an image rasterised into dither
elements.ui: suggested, not shown: selection boxes, hairline guides, tiny cursor and handle marks
elements.shapes: the core of the style: rect, circle, ring, arc, bar, star burst, sparkle, blob
elements.background: electric blue with a fine blueprint grid; flipped to black, white or gold on palette-flip cuts
elements.particles: ordered-dither specks and pixel blocks from dissolving shapes; never glowing sparks

audio.sync: every cut and snap on a beat; palette-flip runs on hi-hat or snare rolls; morphs fill the bar and land on the downbeat; the densest beat (moiré, wireframe) on the drop
audio.sfx: digital clicks and blips for cuts and snaps, short whooshes for morphs, a bit-crushed crackle for pixel dissolves, pops and sparkles for bursts, a soft thud for the slab
